project_name: ORCA - Marine Ecosystem Reasoning with Collaborative Agents

design_philosophy.identity: E1 Anti-AI Designer Strategy: Tactical Maritime Command & High-Density Oceanographic Telemetry
design_philosophy.theme_archetype: ARCHETYPE 5 LUXURY & ARCHETYPE 2 PERFORMANCE PRO FUSION - Tactical Deep-Sea Precision with Swiss Grid Rigor
design_philosophy.emotional_tone: Authoritative, mission-critical, serene deep-ocean intelligence, glassmorphism telemetry HUD, zero-slop Swiss spatial hierarchy
design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Merge Satellite Synthetic Aperture Radar aesthetics with high-contrast Swiss grid system and kinetic glass visual depth.
Emotion First: Evoke deep marine reliability and satellite-grade intelligence for ISRO/INCOIS sea state decisions.
Content is King: Treat every ocean map, PFZ layer, and cyclone warning as an interactive tactical telemetry screen.
Negative Space & Contrast: Use strict grid paddings (p-6/p-8), 1px subtle borders (border-white/10), and crisp high-contrast data callouts.
Anti-Center & Anti-Monotony: Avoid standard centered cards; utilize asymmetrical Bento grid spans (Tetris grid) and tight numeric micro-labels.

fonts.headline: Outfit, Clash Display, or Barlow Condensed (sans-serif display, high weight)
fonts.body: Inter, DM Sans, or Plus Jakarta Sans (clean geometric sans)
fonts.mono: JetBrains Mono or Space Mono (telemetry coordinates, wind knots, SST values)

typography.pairing_strategy: The Swiss Ocean Command: Heavy display headlines with uppercase tracking ([0.2em]) paired with ultra-legible geometric body and monospace telemetry figures.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

rules: DO NOT use Inter or generic sans for Main & Sub-headings; reserve Inter purely for body copy.
Headlines > 32px MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Overlines & micro-labels MUST be Uppercase + Monospace + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

contrast_rules: Maintain minimum 4.5:1 ratio for body text and 3:1 for large display elements.
Never use pure black #000000; use cool slate-tinted deep ocean black (#070F19 or #050B14).
Explicitly set text color on hover states (e.g. hover:bg-cyan-500/20 hover:text-cyan-300).
Header and drop-downs MUST NEVER use 100% transparent backgrounds. Use backdrop-blur-xl (bg-black/60 or bg-white/70).

visual_enhancers.glass_spec: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-slate-950/70 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.37)] backdrop-saturate-150
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Dynamic glowing border gradient animation for active telemetry widgets and high-priority PFZ advisories.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle SVG grid noise overlay (opacity-5) to eliminate flat digital rendered surfaces.
visual_enhancers.card_styles: Cardless or semi-transparent rectangular containers with subtle 1px inner stroke and concentric border-radius (max 8px to 12px).

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: Mode B High Density Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6
grids_and_layouts.marketing_grid: Mode A Tetris Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 with asymmetric spans
grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-aligned content blocks with high-contrast monospace micro-labels; clear hierarchy without center-everything clutter.

motion.micro_interactions: Subtle scale-102 hover transforms, glow border shifts, smooth tab transitions (transition: color 0.2s, background-color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s).
motion.rule: Avoid transition: all to prevent transform breaking. Explicitly declare properties. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

recommended_libraries: React Three Fiber (@react-three/fiber) + Drei for interactive 3D ocean globe and satellite trajectory view
D3.js / Visx for advanced oceanographic temporal heatmaps and ocean depth profiles
TSParticles / Canvas for particle-based ocean current vector flows
implementation_steps: Step 1: Lazy load R3F canvas components inside suspense fallback with ocean shimmer skeletons.
Step 2: Apply transparent canvas background rgba(0,0,0,0) to merge R3F 3D earth node with dark glass UI shell.
Step 3: Add subtle floating animations using Drei Float component and directional studio lights for crisp relief rendering.

selective_high_impact_enhancements.recommendation: Transform standard layout into a floating tactical glass bridge with backdrop-blur-xl, subtle 1px border-white/10, dynamic theme switcher dropdown refinement, and status pingers.
Upgrade to high-density telemetry widget with glowing top-border indicators, monospace metric trend values, and subtle hover elevation.
Add subtle active-state indicator pill, quick status telemetry badge for INCOIS connection, and clean icon-label alignment.
Implement Tetris/Bento telemetry layout: 8-col dominant visual map/copilot panel + 4-col real-time PFZ and marine advisories feed.
Refine AI agent conversation stream with multi-agent avatar chips (Planner, Oceanographer, Weather Agent), inline geospatial map trigger cards, and explainability confidence bars.
Enhance CSS variables with modern glassmorphism tokens, backdrop-filter utilities, custom scrollbar styling, and smooth theme transition hooks.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_requirement: CRITICAL: All interactive buttons, nav links, form controls, map layer toggles, language switches, theme toggles, and data widgets MUST maintain or include data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid="theme-toggle-button", data-testid="copilot-send-button", data-testid="pfz-layer-checkbox").
accessibility_and_testing.motion_accessibility: Ensure all CSS animations respect @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement changes selectively in existing JavaScript files (.jsx/.js) without breaking existing routes, mock data structures, or API client methods. Focus on elevating visual polish, glassmorphism, typography hierarchy, stat cards, and layout grid responsiveness.
